first.title: One step before I answer
first.text: {name} needs a brain to think: a service that writes the answers. The quickest way is free.
first.freeText: A free account on OpenRouter’s site, then back here.
first.also: Also get a private brain for this computer
first.alsoText: {size}, downloaded in the background, for what should stay on this computer.
first.plans: I already use ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot
first.plansText: Answer with the plan you pay for, or a key
first.chooseText: Private, quick or the best answers
first.neutral: {name} has no tie to OpenRouter, nor to any other service here. You can change it any time in Settings.
first.private: My words should stay on this computer
first.privateText: A private brain here, downloaded once ({size}). Simpler, slower answers, and it works without the internet.
first.privateNo: This computer can’t run a private brain.
first.now: I’d like to start right away
first.nowText: A free account on OpenRouter’s site, ready in a minute. It has daily limits, and the answers come from the cloud.
first.best: I want the best answers I can get
first.bestText: With a service you pay for: the ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot plan you already have, or a key from one.
first.names: These names belong to their companies. {name} has no tie to any of them.
first.downloading: Downloading the private brain ({size}). Until it’s ready, answers come from the cloud.
